newsitem.title: USA: Gray Communications to buy NBC-TV affiliate.
newsitem.headline: Gray Communications to buy NBC-TV affiliate.

text.p: Gray Communications Systems Inc on Monday said it will buy WITN-TV Channel 7, an NBC affiliate in the Greenville, N.C., market.
Terms of the deal with Raycom - U.S. Inc were not disclosed.
Gray said WITN is a good fit with its existing group of seven mid-sized television stations in the Southeast. It owns two other NBC affiliates and five CBS affiliates.
The Greenville area is the nation's 105th largest television market with a population of 685,000 and 236,000 television households.
Gray, based in Albany, Ga., also owns three daily newspapers; two advertising weekly shoppers; two satellite uplink and production companies; and a paging business.
